Q: This is the adjuster following up on your claim for the collision. Is it all right if I record this statement?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the vehicle involved. Is that okay?
Q: That works for the file. Can you describe where the collision took place?
A: It was on a two-lane road in Baytown, Texas, near a shopping center entrance. Traffic was light.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was heading toward the center, going slowly because of the turn ahead. The other car came across into my lane.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were traveling?
A: Maybe fifteen miles an hour, not much more. It was more of a bump than a crash.
Q: Did either airbag deploy?
A: No, nothing deployed. Both cars were drivable after we pulled over.
Q: Did you feel any pain at the scene?
A: Not right away. About an hour later my neck started to ache, and by that evening my lower back was stiff and sore.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I was seen by a doctor who diagnosed a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any limits on your daily activities or work?
A: Some. Lifting and sitting for long stretches bother me, and I've had to adjust my schedule a bit.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide my medical records if you need them.
Q: Thnak you. This concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thank you.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
